_doc: Render tiers. draft720 is for iteration on the GTX 970 box; final runs on the RTX 5090 box. Frame rate is set by the style spec at C1.

c5.why: C5 benchmark (log): 1080p at 16 samples is indistinguishable from 64 (mean |diff| 0.6/255; the rest is the dither at cutout edges), at 2.3-6.4 s a frame against 8.8-24 s
